content.title: 90 Easter card messages and sayings to send to everyone
content.text: Paperless Post BlogHolidays > 90 Easter card messages and sayings to send to everyoneMarch 27, 2025 7 min readWhen it comes to sending Easter greetings, there’s no right or wrong way to fill out your Easter card. The most important thing is to write a message that comes from the heart, and that feels right for you and your recipients—whether it’s something sentimental, humorous, sincere, or religious. If you feel like you have more to say, you may also choose to share a sweet photo of your new baby, your new pup, or give an extensive download of what your family’s been up to with a longer Easter letter. Below, you’ll find 90 Easter card messages and quotes to send to everyone in your life. What should you write on an Easter card?Easter greetings for friends and familyReligious Easter greetingsEaster greetings for kidsFunny Easter greetingsFamous Easter quotesSend an Easter card with Paperless Post What should you write on an Easter card? No matter what message you want to convey in your Easter card message, there are a few things you should always include, such as: The date on which you’re writing the card (can be as general as “Easter [year]”) The name of the person to whom you’re writing A joyful message related to Easter A friendly sign-off (such as “Love” or “Best wishes”) Your name and the names of anyone else you’d like attributed to the sending of the card Keep in mind whether you want to send an agnostic Easter card message (think eggs, chicks, Easter bunny, and pastels) or a more religious Easter greeting (think crosses and other religious symbols). You can lean into religious references for the Easter season if you’re sending cards to a loved one who celebrates the Easter holiday. Or send a neutral Happy Easter wish if your friends celebrate other religious holidays or none at all. Read on for some lovely Easter messages to include in your card this year. Easter greetings for friends and family “Spring Lilies” by Paperless Post Whether you’re celebrating together at an Easter party this year or apart, wish all of your friends and family a wonderful Easter with our online Easter cards. Send one card to your entire holiday list to connect with them all, or send individual personal messages to those you hold near and dear. Here are some sample Easter messages to get you started. Happy Easter! Sending you spring wishes this Easter Sunday. Wishing you and yours a very happy Easter. May your Easter be filled with love, hope, and family. Wishing you and your family a happy Easter this spring season. Thinking of you at Easter. Sending you love on Easter. Happy Easter! Sending you spring wishes. May your Easter be filled with colorful treats Hello to you this spring! Easter greetings! Wishing you and yours a happy Easter! Sending Easter happiness from our family to yours. Here’s to a beautiful Easter full of love and light. Sending you love and happiness this Easter. May little chicks and Easter flowers bring into your life the joys of spring. We are celebrating with you in spirit this Easter Sunday. Religious Easter greetings “Blooming Cross” “Risen” by Paperless Post If Christ’s resurrection is the reason for your season, there are many ways to include Easter blessing messages in your Easter card. Wish your community a wonderful and blessed Easter with these religious Easter messages along with an Easter image featuring symbols of the resurrection. You can also edit any baptism card template should you want more religious Easter card options, or contact our Personal Design Services team, who can help with a custom card. May the Lord bless you with health, happiness, and peace. May your Easter be filled with lilies, those white-robed apostles of hope. He is risen! May the Lord bless you. “Blessed are those who have not seen and have yet believed.” – John 20:29 Wishing you a blessed Easter. May all your prayers be fulfilled this Easter. Let us celebrate this day of hope, renewal, and new life. Sending you beautiful Easter blessings. Rejoice! Our lord lives and so does our hope. May the Resurrection of our Lord and Savior serve as a constant reminder of His love. May your faith be strengthened by the miracle of the Resurrection. May your heart be filled with the purest form of love and the Lord give you the courage to walk on the right path this Easter. This Easter, may God’s blessings come overflowing. Rejoice in the risen Savior, who has conquered death and granted us eternal life. Easter greetings for kids “Bunny Feeling” by Paperless Post With all the yummy candy, fun egg hunts, and Easter bunny lore, Easter celebrations were practically made for children. Send a sweet Easter sentiment to the little ones in your life with inspiration from the following messages. May your Easter be filled with lots of chocolate eggs! You are one egg-stra special kid. Hope you have an egg-ceptionally sweet Easter. There’s no bunny else like you! Happy Easter from somebunny who loves you very much. Hope your Easter is extra hoppy! Easter is about more than candy (but there’s nothing wrong with getting candy, too!) Have a cracking good Easter! You are my favorite Easter blessing. Happy Easter to my favorite Peep! May you win every egg hunt this Easter! Happy Easter to my little Easter bunny. I love you! Being your parent is sweeter than all the chocolate eggs in the world. You make my heart hop, little one! Hop till you drop! Send you bunny kisses and Easter wishes. Have the hoppiest Easter, my little chick! I ‘hop’ the Easter Bunny treats you right! Funny Easter greetings Missing some bunny this Easter? Wish family, friends, and kids a wonderful Easter with a funny Easter message. Read on for some amusing Easter message inspiration with clever puns and silly jokes. Happy Easter from the other Easter bunny! To my favorite chick! I ‘carrot’ about you a lot. How does the Easter Bunny feel after he works out? Eggs-austed! Hand over the Easter eggs and no-bunny gets hurt! When life gives you lemons, throw them back and ask for chocolate eggs, instead! [From a chocolate rabbit] I tried to send a meaningful Easter message, but I’m hollow inside! Without you, I’d go off the Peep end. Have a hippity-hoppity-happity Easter! What did one funny Easter egg say to the other? “You crack me up!” Follow the bunny… he has the chocolate! After Easter Sunday comes Tummy Ache Monday! What fairytales do the Easter bunny like best? The ones with hop-py endings! Easter is all about spending time with family chocolate! Therapist: “How are you?” Chocolate bunny: “Not great… I feel so hollow inside.” Sorry I ate all of the chocolate… Happy Easter! You make my heart hop out of my chest! Have a happy Easter, for Peep’s sake! Show me the bunny! I always have a good ‘hare’ day on Easter! Famous Easter quotes Easter comes at a wonderful, inspiring of the year—spring—so it’s no surprise that there are so many beautiful quotes about the holiday, rebirth, love, and togetherness. Read below for some Easter quotes that you may want to share with the people you love. “I still believe in Santa, the Easter Bunny, the Tooth Fairy, and true love. Don’t even try to tell me different.” – Dolly Parton “Easter is the only time when it’s perfectly safe to put all of your eggs in one basket.” – Evan Esar “Like Easter egg hunts, the disciples knew what it was like to be in search for Jesus.” – Seth Vopat “Easter is very important to me. It’s a second chance.” – Reba McEntire “The very first Easter taught us this: that life never ends and love never dies.” – Kate McGahan “The Easter egg symbolizes our ability to break out of the hardened, protective shell we’ve surrounded ourselves with that limits our thoughts and beliefs. As we break open our hearts and minds we discover a transformation to new, life-enhancing thoughts and beliefs.” – Siobhan Shaw “Egg hunts are proof that your children can find things when they really want.” – Unknown “If Easter says anything to us today, it says this: You can put truth in a grave but it won’t stay there.” – Clarence W. Hall “Easter is the soul’s first taste of spring.” – Richelle E. Goodrich “There would be no Christmas if there was no Easter.” – Gordon P. Hinckley “On Easter Day, the veil between time and eternity thins to gossamer.” – Douglas Horton “The day the Lord created hope was probably the same day He created spring.” – Bernard Williams “For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.” – John 3:16 “Easter is meant to be a symbol of hope, renewal, and new life.” – Janine di Giovanni “Easter is one of my favorite holidays with the kids. They get to run loose, and we always have our family and loved ones all around us!” – Camila Alves “‘Twas Easter Sunday. The full-blossomed trees filled all the air with fragrance and with joy.” – Henry Wadsworth Longfellow “Easter combines the best of the present with the traditions of the past—like Cadbury cream eggs with hunting and gathering.” – Melanie White “Dawn and resurrection are synonymous. The reappearance of the light is the same as the survival of the soul.” – Victor Hugo “It’s when you crack open a chocolate Easter egg, that smiles emerge.” – Anthony T. Hicks “Easter tells us that life is to be interpreted not simply in terms of things but in terms of ideals.” – Charles M.
